content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(AISPM-007 Reasoning-Engine Agent Container Recursive IMDS P4SA Token Harvest) AND (ABIOC(AISPM-007 P4SA Service Agent Cross-Project Cloud Storage Read Deviation) OR XQL(AISPM-007 P4SA Artifact Registry Private Reasoning-Engine Image Pull)) — join the in-cluster recursive-IMDS harvest and the cloud-plane P4SA activity on the shared P4SA principal and the reasoning-engine causality_actor_process into ONE Vertex AI double-agent incident, so the cross-project GCS read and the private image pull are attributed to the deployed agent that owns the chain rather than surfacing as isolated cloud audit lines.
rules.name: Vertex AI Double Agent — P4SA Token Theft Stitched To Cross-Project GCS And Image Exfil
